hazard.cause: Fire heat met Aurora-bearing ice and the ground shattered between them.
Ocean Pressure entered conductive Fire fractures and the shore boiled.
Pressure reached charged coastal ice and breached it.
Fire quickened a Greenwood until it rotted and its springs boiled.
Aurora held a Salt barrow still and its dead did not rest.
